On Linux, produce a new per-frame egui snapshot after xclip staging with an advancing frame/log marker and explicit raw-event list, including empty; then sample the +1 pointer move separately. Do not issue +2 after failed +1. If +2 is diagnosed later, use a separate paste-disabled trial after a fresh click and geometry check.
At each Linux checkpoint capture monotonic timestamp, frame/line, pointer/button state, both widgets ID/focus/hover/rect, refresh state, and X11 focused window ID/title.
Keep Ctrl+V unreachable unless the existing full pre-paste guard passes; preserve exact source bytes and post-save checks.
Persist a compact field-by-field C07.4 acceptance breakdown before throwing; do not truncate those predicates.
